cpu_class: TBD — reference CPU class by decision record (e.g. one named server-class x86-64 microarchitecture generation; whatever is chosen excludes someone and the record says whom)
frequency_policy: fixed or governor=performance; turbo state recorded
statistic: median of per-operation wall-clock; p99 reported

sandbox.inputs: read-only bind of fixtures and the trusted baseline
sandbox.outputs: one writable directory; the sandboxed process cannot write score.json or result.json
sandbox.trusted_parent: the harness scorer runs outside the sandbox, computes the measurements and the scalar, canonicalises and signs the result
